scope: FlashAttention host dispatch/support/scratch planning for Apex only: DKQ=DV=256, Q GGML_TYPE_F32, K/V GGML_TYPE_Q4_0, mask GGML_TYPE_F16, padded cache (K->ne[1]%FATTN_KQ_STRIDE==0, FATTN_KQ_STRIDE=256), GQA 16/2=8, CUDA Ada (cc 890). All other native configurations are still routed exactly but reported deferred for the parent's preserved native path. No architecture changes; no forced fallback.
mirrors: fattn.cu: ggml_cuda_flash_attn_ext (dispatch), ggml_cuda_flash_attn_ext_supported, ggml_cuda_flash_attn_ext_get_alloc_size, ggml_cuda_get_best_fattn_kernel, ggml_cuda_fattn_kv_type_supported, ggml_cuda_get_fattn_vec_case

fattn-common.cuh: ggml_cuda_flash_attn_ext_get_f16_extra_data, launch_fattn (staging strides, sparse/scan scratch, occupancy and wave-efficiency loop, stream-K policy, grid/block shapes, fixup and combine routing)
fattn-vec.cuh: ggml_cuda_flash_attn_ext_vec_case[_impl] (cols_per_block 1/2, softcap variant, nthreads=128, nbatch_fa=D, warp 32)

fattn-mma-f16.cuh: mma_f16 head switch (64..576 incl. 192/320/576 special cases), switch_ncols1/2, may/shall_use_sparse, get_config_ampere, case host planning (shared-memory sizes, setattr memo, async_kv_preload)
common.cuh: arch predicates, init_fastdiv_values divisors (bridge computes), device info, GGML_PAD 128
roles: packet args [role,device,dst]. role=0: alloc size -> plan 3/0 (f16-extra end minus (uintptr)dst->data). role=1: plan 3/29 native-supported (route!=0), 3/28 deferred. role=2: full planning plus ordered effects; route 0 aborts (fail 29, GGML_ABORT path). Op re-checked (fail 28).
routes: best_fattn_kernel enums exact: NONE=0, VEC=100, TILE=200, MMA_F16=400 (plan 3/1). Ada with quantized K/V: Q->ne[1]<=2 -> VEC (small query), else MMA_F16 prefill chain; ncols2=8 (gqa>4, padded+aligned), ncols1 via sparse (1) or 8/16/32/64-minus-ncols2 ladder. Vec: cols_per_block = Q->ne[1]==1?1:2; vec pair id plan 3/21 (U64_MAX = native f16-fallback F16-F16 instance, planned with staging). TILE never planned by Goose (deferred).
deferred: plan 3/28=1 iff route==TILE, route==NONE, or MMA with non-ampere build family (carch<800 or non-NVIDIA). Parent runs native dispatch for deferred nodes; Goose effects only when 3/28==0. get_alloc_size and supported stay exact for every route.

effects_order: setdev -> f16_extra metadata -> K conv -> V conv -> [sparse: pool0 + compact launch] -> [scan: pool0 + scan launch] -> occ -> pool1/pool2 -> main launch -> fixup/combine launches; identical to native launch_fattn ordering.
assumptions: Apex build compiles vec instances pair 0 (F16-F16) and pair 8 (Q4_0-Q4_0) for D 64/128/256 (GGML_CUDA_FA_F16_F16, GGML_CUDA_FA_Q4_0_Q4_0); every other pair returns nullptr and takes the native f16-fallback behavior (with staging) exactly; never forced by this module
Ada: cc 890 NVIDIA, carch>=800 -> ampere config table; stream-K always on cc>=890; async_kv_preload for dense mma with ncols2>=2 (cp-async nstages=2)
WARP_SIZE=32; half=2B; half2=4B; Q4_0 block=18B; GGML_PAD(...,128) for stage alignment
op_params: float[0]=scale, float[1]=max_bias, float[2]=logit_softcap, int32[4]=n_kv_max (read only on sparse paths; may be uninitialized when dense, native identical)
is_quantized == type not in {F32,F16,BF16}: exact within the FA type universe; other types already yield NONE via kv_type_supported
n_head_log2 = highest power of two <= Q->ne[2] (equals floorf(log2f(float(n))) for all n<2^24; heads never reach that)
ggml enum values only via fg175h_tc/oc; tensor struct layout never reconstructed (ggml-impl.h not among inputs)
V_is_K_view via view_src/view_offs (ti k8/k9): V->view_src && (V->view_src==K || (V->view_src==K->view_src && V->view_offs==K->view_offs))
overflow: all products through checked u64 mul (fail 1); divisions guarded (fail 3); grids bounded x<=2^31-1, y,z<=65535 (fail 25; CUDA launch limits, same abort outcome as native CUDA_CHECK); staging size = dst_nbytes + pad128 + nelements*2 per staged tensor, u64 like native size_t.
out_of_scope: TILE kernel planning (deferred), non-ampere GPU families (deferred), numerical vec/MMA kernels (other Goose modules), f16 conversion and pool internals, compile/GPU/performance claims (parent owns checks).
